       {"id": "c", "text": "It is an agent, because it calls a model and also uses an if statement to branch"},

       {"id": "c", "text": "Keep a fixed workflow: the steps never vary, so code can run them cheaply and predictably"},

result:
The quiz is at `quizzes/0002.json`, and its key is at `keys/0002.json`. I did not check that the two JSON files parse; my attempt to run a parser was blocked, and I wrote them by hand.

- **Length:** It has ten questions, although you asked for six. The quiz is longer than asked because you prefer ten, half definitions and half application.
- **Order:** Q1 to Q5 are definition questions: control flow, workflow, agent, what autonomy costs, and what a fixed workflow gives up. Q6 to Q10 apply them to makerspace cases.
- **Cost question:** Q8 is a numeric question on monthly model cost for the booking path. The learner has to decide which design fits before doing the arithmetic.
- **No lesson yet:** No lesson covers O4, so the quiz is ahead of the lessons. I built it from Anthropic's "Building effective agents". Your notes say workflows versus agents has not been taught, so the definition questions will be a first exposure. You may want to teach O4 first, or treat this as a pre-test.
- **Review:** The `quiz-reviewer` subagent checked the draft in two passes. I fixed the findings it raised after the first pass, and the second pass's findings were fixed in the final revision. I checked option lengths and the cost question myself afterwards. The log is in `review-records/0002-quiz.md`.
- **Misconception ids:** I couldn't read `keys/0001.json`, so the ids M10 to M25 in the new key are my own and may clash with ids already used there.

It is ready when the learner is.

Sources:
- [Building effective agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents)
